title: Sanger Tree of Life HMW DNA Extraction: Automated Plant MagAttract v.4
author: Benjamin Jackson

steps.title: Prepare Heat Blocks
steps.instruction: Set up two heat blocks: one with a 50 mL SmartBlock at 65 °C and another with a 2 mL SmartBlock at 55 °C.

steps.title: Prepare Lysis Buffer Master Mix
steps.instruction: Prepare a lysis buffer master mix in a 50 mL centrifuge tube using 200 µL Phosphate buffered solution (PBS) and 150 µL Buffer AL per sample.

substeps.instruction: Place the lysis buffer on the 65 °C heat block and incubate at 400 rpm for at least 20 minutes.
Keep at temperature until added to the sample.

steps.title: Prepare Tissue Samples
steps.instruction: Transfer 50 mg of cryogenically disrupted tissue (fine powder, no clumps) from each sample into 2 mL microcentrifuge tubes.

substeps.instruction: Transfer samples to a pre-chilled cold block on wet ice and incubate for 10 minutes to equilibrate temperature.

steps.title: Initiate Lysis
steps.instruction: Add 20 µL Proteinase K (for n+1 samples) to the preheated lysis buffer and swirl to mix immediately prior to lysis.

substeps.instruction: Add 370 µL of the preheated lysis buffer plus Proteinase K to each sample.
Immediately homogenize the lysate with 5 rapid pulse vortexes.
Place on the 55 °C heat block at 600 rpm for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Perform Lysis and RNase Treatment
steps.instruction: Complete the lysis process and remove RNA from the samples.

substeps.instruction: After 5 minutes of incubation, resuspend any severely aggregated samples using a wide-bore pipette tip.
After the initial 15 minute incubation, add 4 µL RNase A to each sample and mix thoroughly by inversion until all particles are resuspended.
Incubate samples for a further 45 minutes on the heat block at 55 °C at 600 rpm.
Occasionally mix by inversion every 5–15 minutes, but do not mix by inversion for the final 15 minutes of lysis to allow particles to settle.

steps.title: Recover Lysate
steps.instruction: Separate the lysate from the cellular debris.

substeps.instruction: Remove tubes from the heat block and allow lysate to settle for 5 minutes.
Centrifuge samples for 10 minutes at 8,000 rpm at room temperature.
Using a wide-bore pipette tip set to 380 µL, gently transfer lysate to individual wells in the sample plate, avoiding the pellet.

steps.title: Automated DNA Extraction
steps.instruction: Perform the primary DNA extraction using the KingFisher™ Apex instrument.

substeps.instruction: Select the required DNA extraction protocol on the KingFisher™ Apex and press play.
Load the filled plates onto the instrument following on-screen instructions.
Remove the 'Tip Plate' when prompted before loading the 'Sample Plate'.
Allow the protocol to run (approximately 50 minutes) and remove plates upon completion.

steps.title: Clean Eluates
steps.instruction: Ensure eluates are free of magnetic beads.

substeps.instruction: Inspect elution plates for beads.
If beads are present, transfer the sample to a 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube and place on a magnetic rack for 5 minutes.
Collect the clear DNA eluate using a wide-bore pipette tip.

steps.title: Prepare 0.45X SPRI Setup
steps.instruction: Set up the KingFisher plates for the 0.45X SPRI process.

substeps.instruction: Prepare the following plates: Tip Plate (1 mL Deep-well, 96-well tip comb), Sample Plate (1 mL Deep-well, 380 µL DNA + 171 µL AMPure PB beads), Ethanol Wash Plate (1 mL Deep-well, 1000 µL 80% EtOH), and Elution Plate (200 µL standard, 135 µL Buffer EB).
Using a 200 µL multi-channel pipette and wide-bore tips, pipette eluates from Elution Plate 2 into Elution Plate 1 and gently pipette mix 5–10 times.

steps.title: Prepare Additional SPRI Plates
steps.instruction: Label and fill nine 1 mL 96-well deep-well KingFisher™ plates as follows:

substeps.instruction: Tip plate: 96-well tip comb (no reagent)
Elution 2: 200 µL Buffer AE
Elution 1: 200 µL Buffer AE
NFW: 500 µL Nuclease-Free Water
PE Wash: 2700 µL Buffer PE
PE Wash 1: 1700 µL Buffer PE
MW1 Wash: 2700 µL Buffer MW1
MW1 Wash 1: 1700 µL Buffer MW1
Sample plate: 15 µL Suspension G magnetic beads and 280 µL Buffer MB

steps.title: Automated 0.45X SPRI
steps.instruction: Perform the 0.45X SPRI cleanup using the KingFisher™ Apex instrument.

substeps.instruction: Select the 0.45X SPRI protocol on the KingFisher™ Apex and press play.
Load the filled plates onto the instrument following on-screen instructions.
Allow the protocol to run (approximately 40 minutes) and remove plates upon completion.

steps.title: Final Recovery and Storage
steps.instruction: Recover the final DNA and store.

substeps.instruction: Using a wide-bore pipette tip, transfer 130 µL of eluate from the elution plate into microcentrifuge tubes.
Incubate DNA at room temperature overnight.
Perform QC the following morning.
Store DNA at 4 °C.
